task.title: Restore controllable login workflow preview motion
task.objective: Keep the pre-auth workflow preview decorative and motionless by default when the operating system requests reduced motion, while giving the owner an explicit accessible per-app opt-in to animate it. Strengthen the real-Electron proof so it verifies progression, reduced-motion stability, and the explicit opt-in without changing authentication behavior, providers, or the existing login DOM contract.

authentication: Do not change the SecurityGate state machine, authentication calls, provider behavior, or the existing login DOM contract.
The workflow preview remains aria-hidden decorative sample data and must never be presented as live telemetry.
accessibility: The system reduced-motion preference remains the default: preview motion is paused until the owner explicitly opts in.
The opt-in control has a clear accessible name and state, and works without pointer-only interaction.
ui: Use existing design tokens and the current Login layout; do not redesign the approved Login surface.

acceptance.description: The normal-motion preview visibly advances through its fixed sample steps. When the operating system asks for reduced motion, it remains stable until the owner explicitly enables preview motion, after which the preview advances without changing authentication behavior.
The Bead, task evidence, AI memory, assignments, and derived roadmap sources agree before exact terminal closeout.
